consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of P-3223 during cleaning and preparation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on P-3223 and M-3223 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically selecting isolation points and devices. P-3223 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 27 November 2020 an incident occurred on P-3223 and M-3223 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
